text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Hand-painted transparent watercolor on cold-press paper, original fairytale palace courtyard filled with iris flower beds and a shallow reflecting pool, delicate warm ivory arches, loose wet-on-wet lavender and sage washes, fine architectural pencil lines, organic paper grain. Immersive environment, not a framed sketch.
